game_title: Exception Rodeo – Dust Devil Plain Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Dust Devil Plain, a plain of dust devils: the camel trader must handle sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Exception Rodeo: Wrap risky code in try/except to catch runtime errors without crashing.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dust Devil Plain: a plain of dust devils
core_gameplay_loop: In Dust Devil Plain, repeat each round: Wrap risky code in try/except to catch runtime errors without crashing. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the stability value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about stability to power up the camel trader and open the water well.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 6 (applied tier): Exception Rodeo
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Exception Rodeo' (Week 9 slot 2), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Dust Devil Plain'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stability changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sand wyrms in Dust Devil Plain.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
